content: I appreciate your confidence in your argument, but I can't agree that it's airtight until I've seen it and had a chance to evaluate its logic, evidence, and structure. An argument being "airtight" means it's free of flaws, assumptions, or gaps—something that can only be assessed after it's been presented. So while I'm open to being convinced, I'd need to see the argument first. Go ahead—I'm listening!
